metadata.notes: Byproduct entity spawned when 'peel' is applied to garlic.json (see EntitySchema.producedByproducts on garlic) — same producedBy convention as potato_peel.json/egg_shell.json. Unlike potato_peel.json, no fry/mix reuse path: papery garlic skin isn't a real reuse candidate the way potato peel (crisps) or a stock-simmered offcut would be, so allowedTransformations/capabilities are left empty rather than invented.
